### Properties

#### EstimatedCompletionUtc

```text
System.DateTime EstimatedCompletionUtc { get; }
```

Gets the estimated completion time (UTC).


#### InstantRatePerSecond

```text
System.Double InstantRatePerSecond { get; set; }
```

Gets the instantaneous processing rate (records per second) based on a rolling window. Warning: This value can fluctuate wildly in batch operations when multiple batches complete at once. For most display purposes, use P:PPDS.Dataverse.Progress.ProgressSnapshot.RatePerSecond instead.


#### OverallRatePerSecond

```text
System.Double OverallRatePerSecond { get; set; }
```

Gets the overall processing rate (records per second) since start. This is the stable rate used for ETA calculations. Same as P:PPDS.Dataverse.Progress.ProgressSnapshot.RatePerSecond.


#### PercentComplete

```text
System.Double PercentComplete { get; }
```

Gets the percentage complete (0-100).


#### RatePerSecond

```text
System.Double RatePerSecond { get; }
```

Gets the processing rate (records per second) - total records divided by elapsed time. Use this rate for display and throughput reporting.


#### Failed

```text
System.Int64 Failed { get; set; }
```

Gets the number of failed records.


#### Processed

```text
System.Int64 Processed { get; }
```

Gets the total number of processed records (succeeded + failed).


#### Remaining

```text
System.Int64 Remaining { get; }
```

Gets the remaining records to process.


#### Succeeded

```text
System.Int64 Succeeded { get; set; }
```

Gets the number of successfully processed records.


#### Total

```text
System.Int64 Total { get; set; }
```

Gets the total number of records to process.


#### Elapsed

```text
System.TimeSpan Elapsed { get; set; }
```

Gets the elapsed time since tracking started.


#### EstimatedRemaining

```text
System.TimeSpan EstimatedRemaining { get; set; }
```

Gets the estimated time remaining based on overall rate. Returns F:System.TimeSpan.MaxValue if rate is zero.
